version.description: Script format version, MAJOR.MINOR. A minor increase is additive and older scripts keep working; a major increase means existing scripts must be rewritten. prescript rejects a version it does not recognise rather than ignoring what it cannot read. See docs/script-format.md.

redactions.description: Named patterns for the parts of a line that vary between runs, referred to from a step's line as {{name}}. Declared once for the whole script so two runs being compared normalise the same things the same way. Added in 0.4.

env.description: Environment for the child process. Omit it and the child inherits prescript's environment. Declare it and the child gets exactly these variables and nothing else, unless inheritEnv is also set. Added in 0.2.

terminal.description: What the program finds on its standard streams. 'pty' (the default) gives it a pseudo-terminal, which is what an interactive program is normally run under; 'pipes' does not. Added in 0.6.

inheritEnv.description: Put prescript's own environment underneath the declared env, rather than replacing it. Has no effect unless env is declared. Added in 0.2.

isRegex.description: Match the whole line as a regular expression. Superseded by redactions, which keep the line readable as the output it stands for; see docs/script-format.md.
